what: Loader panel — the text lines rise from 160% below over .85s outQuint in .1 steps, and a 1px bar draws from the left with inOutQuint while the white tag (000%) at its end unfolds vertically. Each time a file is received, the value fills to the received share over ”remaining share × 3 seconds (.6~2.5)” with inOutQuint, the tag follows the end of the bar (inset by the tag width), and the line below switches to the current file name. When everything is received or max seconds pass, it fills to 100% within 1.6s, then .1s later the bar folds back to the left end over .85s while the text slides down in reverse, after which the panel disappears and fires fx:done
needs: CustomEase (if available, keeps the original curve as is)

options.files: Comma-separated list of file names to show — if present, treated as received at .35s intervals, if absent, it actually waits for the page’s img and video
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: 1px bar (required) — the part builds the fill and tag inside it
options.[data-fx-part=title] · [data-fx-part=ite: Title · file name line · description (if any)

use:
Loading media

from.where: index·works·about·detail.html .gb-loader — original Loader(Dpzvsrlm): default {.85, outQuint}, text 160 stagger line/word ×.1, bar scaleX 0 inOutQuint, tag scaleY 0 · text scaleY 2 · yPercent 100, value clamp(.6, 2.5, diff×3) inOutQuint, end v(1, 1.6) → bar scale 0 .85 delay .1 → reversed → +.2s hide

note: The original splits text down to words with SplitText — the part lifts by line (if split words are needed, the caller splits them in advance with SplitText)
